description: This file defines the BasicSearchEngine class within the SuiteCRM project, implementing search functionality for the Basic Search feature, including methods for executing searches, handling search modules, and building filter fields.

classes.name: BasicSearchEngine
classes.description: A class extending SearchEngine that implements basic search functionalities for SuiteCRM, including executing searches and constructing search queries.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search based on the provided SearchQuery object, returning SearchResults with timing and total hits.

methods.name: searchModules
methods.description: Performs search operations across specified modules, constructing where clauses, handling list view data, and aggregating results.

methods.name: buildFilterFields
methods.description: Builds an array of filter fields for list view data search, excluding relationship and non-list-show fields.
